$Comment: Bram's secret has two keys, and this factor reads 1 when the player holds either: his apprentice quest
done and collected (ziggfreedcommon:quest_completed, christmas_bram_apprentice), which works on every
server, or Woodcutting level 20 (the factor Christmas_Bram_Skill), which exists only where MMO Skill
Tree runs. Formula adds the two and Clamp holds the sum at 1. Bram's extra roll in every Christmas
Present asks for it with Min 1 (Lootables/SeasonsOfOrbis/Christmas_Bram_Present.json), of the player who
opens the present. Nothing shows a lock line on it, so it carries no name.
